# Programming-language standard — bhojpuri

*Localization of existing standards (ISO/IEC 9899, 14882, IEEE 1800/1076, …) — not re-authorship.*

Script/locale: Devanagari · register: dialect · (C) 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary, GPL.

| construct | this language | Romenagri (ASCII-7) | C | localizes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `if` | जब | `jaba` | `if` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.4.1 |
| `else` | नाहीं_त | `naahee_m_ta` | `else` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.4.1 |
| `while` | जबले | `jabalee` | `while` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.1 |
| `for` | खातिर | `khaa_tira` | `for` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.3 |
| `return` | लौटा | `lou_taa` | `return` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.6.4 |
| `int` | गिनती | `gina_tee` | `int` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `void` | खाली | `khaalee` | `void` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `printf` | बोलअ | `boala` | `printf` | ISO/IEC 9899 §7.21.6.3 |
| `break` | छोड़ | `chhoa_rda` | `break` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.6.3 |
| `main` | मुख | `mukha` | `main` | ISO/IEC 9899 §5.1.2.2.1 |

**Semantics are preserved**: each row maps a surface keyword onto the canonical construct; the execution target (GCC today, neuromorphic tomorrow) never sees the linguistic layer.
